 Hi Friends,

 I have an urgent requirement from one of my esteem client, I will appreciate if you can have an eye on the below requirement and send me your consultant updated profile ASAP. 
 
 Title: Java Developer with Micro services exp MUST 
 Location: Cincinnati, OH 
 Duration: 12 months+ (Potential for extension) 
 
 Desired Skills: Restful API integration, Java, Micro Services (exposure) 
 
 Job Description: 
 We are in search of an experienced Web Services Developer with at least 5+ years of experience. An ideal candidate will have worked in large coding environments. Kroger has 100s of thousands of lines of code so referencing libraries, design patterns, etc. which can be complex. 
 
 Desired Experience: 
 
 • 5+ years of Java development experience 
 • Experience with project planning with large size or highly complex projects 
 • Experience with Java, Rest APIs, Spring, Micro Services 
 • Experience working in an Agile Scrum environment 
 • Proven communication and presentation skills to effectively communicate information to customers and to all levels within the organization. 
 • Ability to interact well in a team environment. 
 
 Desired Technical Skills: 
 · Rest APIs (not SOAP APIs) 
 · Java 
 · Spring 
 · Spring Boot 
 · JSON 
 · XML 
 · Micro Services Architecture (General experience) 
 · Cassandra – Nice to have 
 · MongoDB – Nice to have 


 If my requirement matches your resume, then please do reply on my email id alih (at) usmsystems(dot)com  and contact no is 703-955-3955
